note: Set A is preferred because it captures the critical Top of Steel elevation (11'-4") and the main South Elevation span (32'-0"), which Set B misses. Set B correctly identifies the HSS4X6X1/4 member size that Set A omits, but missing the primary building height and total span is a more significant omission for a framing elevation sheet. Both sets share errors in binding the 2'-0" dimension to the West Elevation and mislabeling the 2'-4" floor level as a horizontal dimension.
